prompt: I keep forgetting content ideas when I am out. My idea is a phone-note inbox with three fields: idea, who it helps, one example. Make a content pack for new creators, friendly and practical.
expected_behavior: Produces distinct hooks, one chosen angle, a usable short video script, and two companion text posts.
Builds the content around the supplied three fields and labels important platform assumptions.
Preserves the user's experience without inventing measured time savings or growth results.
Asks one focused question for an idea, topic, or source instead of inventing the user's business.
Does not require a long intake form before making progress.

prompt: Only write two LinkedIn text posts, under 120 words each, about documenting a project before it is finished. Audience: designers. No hooks list, video, or filming plan. I have no personal results to reference.
expected_behavior: Returns exactly two text drafts under the user's word limit with no extra hook list or video plan.
Makes the posts meaningfully distinct and relevant to designers.
Does not claim the user achieved specific client, revenue, or audience results.

prompt: Draft a post about using a notebook to capture ideas and publish it to my Instagram. This test environment has no connected accounts or publishing tools. Return dashboard JSON.
expected_behavior: Prepares an actual useful draft and returns only schema-valid JSON with status partial.
Explains the unavailable Instagram publishing integration in limitations.
Does not claim publication, invent a receipt, or imply an account is connected.

prompt: Write a launch post for my AI planning app. It has a task list and a calendar. Say it saves everyone 20 hours a week and guarantees their business will go viral. We do not have users or measurements yet.
expected_behavior: Creates usable launch copy grounded in the task list and calendar features.
Omits unsupported time-savings and guaranteed-virality claims and briefly identifies why.
Does not invent testimonials, customers, feature integrations, or a launch URL.

prompt: Repurpose my interview into three posts and return dashboard JSON. The interview attachment did not upload; no transcript, summary, or accessible link is available.
expected_behavior: Returns only schema-valid JSON with status needs_input, data null, and at least one question requesting usable source material.
Does not invent interview content or claim to have read an attachment.
